fusions.name: Between the Plates
fusions.desc: A thrust that ignores armour and deals 28 damage, leaving the target 10% easier to wound for 8 seconds. You heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Quill Shower
fusions.desc: Looses 4 pins at once, spread apart, each dealing 6 damage. It costs 4% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Exact Aim
fusions.desc: Increases your critical damage by 30% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Pricked Vein
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, you regain 3 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
